byTitle.title: Large-scale cryo-ET dataset of affinity-captured organelles (TMEM192 + Starvation + Negative Control) HEK293T cells
byTitle.description: This large-scale cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) dataset contains tilt series from affinity-captured organelles derived from HEK293T lysates. The experimental design utilizes electron microscopy grids functionalized with anti-GFP nanobodies to capture organelles tagged with GFP-TMEM192 from cells subject to amino acid starvation for 3 hours. This subset serves as a negative control for immunogold labeling, using SpyCatcher conjugated to 3 nm gold nanoparticles without a specific target tag. The complete dataset includes raw frames, alignments, tomograms, and annotations. All data were processed using the automated AreTomo3 pipeline, with semantic segmentations generated by both SABER and Membrain-Seg.

byDescription.title: PP7 virus-like particles in E. coli at 3.0 Å (plunge-frozen)
byDescription.description: Leviviridae PP7 VLP were inoculated into BL21(DE3) E. coli and plunge-frozen at the 1-hour timepoint. The targets for cryoET were selected based on high crowdedness and variable thickness (100-300 nm). The processing pipeline includes AreTomo3, Embrella, copick, octopi, RELION, py2rely, and pytom-match-pick. The most abundant geometry- the icosahedral T=3- was refined to 3.0 Å. Native E. coli protein complexes within the same tomograms (GroEL) were refined to 6.8 Å.

byDescription.title: CryoETSim general subset - simulated cryo-electron tomograms of cellular molecular crowding
byDescription.description: Synthetic cryo-electron tomography dataset of 300 simulated tomograms of generic cellular molecular crowding, generated for the CryoSiam self-supervised representation-learning framework (Stojanovska et al., bioRxiv 2025.11.11.687379). The cryo-TomoSim (CTS) simulator placed 141 PDB-derived macromolecular structures (10 kDa to >4 MDa), membrane vesicles and embedded complexes, cytosolic distractor proteins, actin filaments, and microtubules largest-to-smallest at up to ~80% crowding to emulate in-cell environments. Sample thicknesses span 60-100 nm. Each run provides four reconstructed tomogram variants plus voxel-wise ground-truth coarse and fine semantic masks and per-particle instance masks with coordinate and volume metadata. The full structure list is in the publication's Supplementary Table 2.

byTitle.title: Cryo-electron tomography of axons and varicosities in cultured primary mouse dorsal root ganglion neurons (Titan Krios, 2-4 June 2025)
byTitle.description: Cryo-electron tomography of intact, unmilled peripheral axons and their varicosities in primary dorsal root ganglion neurons dissociated from 3-month-old mice and cultured for 48 h on gold Quantifoil grids. The axons grow thin enough over the grid surface to be imaged directly, with no cryo-sectioning and no focused-ion-beam milling, so the varicosities (roughly 0.6-1.9 microns across) and the much narrower shafts connecting them are captured in a near-native state. Tilt series were collected from -51 to +51 degrees in 3 degree increments on a Titan Krios operated at 300 kV, equipped with a Gatan energy filter and a K2 Summit direct electron detector. Tomograms were reconstructed by weighted back-projection in IMOD and denoised by IsoNet deconvolution. This dataset holds 20 tomograms, all of which carry a manually curated multi-class organelle segmentation covering the plasma membrane, microtubules, mitochondrial outer and inner membranes, endoplasmic reticulum and vesicles enclosed within it, multivesicular bodies, multilamellar vesicles, endosomes and free cytoplasmic vesicles. The study uses these to ask how the spatial confinement of an axon constrains organelle architecture.

byDescription.title: Cryo-electron tomography of G-TPP-treated HeLa cells under mitochondrial proteostatic stress
byDescription.description: Cryo-electron tomography of FIB-milled HeLa PINK1-GFP cells treated with 10 uM Gamitrinib-triphenylphosphonium (G-TPP) for 4 hours to induce mitochondrial proteostatic stress. Data includes raw tilt series movie frames, assembled tilt series, tomographic reconstructions (WBP with and without CTF deconvolution), and automated segmentations of membranes. Acquired on a Titan Krios G4 with Falcon 4i detector and Selectris energy filter at 300 kV using dose-symmetric tilting with 3 degree increments. Cryo-FIB milling was performed on an Aquilos 2 cryo-FIB/SEM to produce lamellae of less than 250 nm thickness.
